testcase.name: Scenario: Apply a ribbon customization during a modeling command: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1820:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Apply a ribbon customization during a modeling command ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its solid block in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is visible ✔ And the Part Tools custom panel target is initially empty ✔ When the user starts Shell from Modify ✔ And the user selects the Tools ribbon tab ✔ And the user opens the Options panel title context menu ✔ And the user selects Customize User Commands ✔ And the user adds 2D Sketches to the Part Tools target ✔ And the user clicks Apply ✔ Then the customization dialog remains open ✔ And the target list retains 2D Sketches without a pending marker ✔ And the User Commands panel is visible behind the dialog ✔ And the Shell properties and model preview remain visible behind the dialog ✔ When the user removes 2D Sketches from the Part Tools target ✔ And the user clicks Apply ✔ Then the Part Tools target is empty without a pending marker ✔ And the User Commands panel remains visible behind the dialog ✔ And the Shell properties and model preview remain visible behind the dialog ✔ When the user closes customization ✔ Then the User Commands panel is removed ✔ And the Shell properties and model preview remain visible ✔ When the user cancels Shell ✔ Then the command properties and preview close ✔ And the original solid block remains visible
